magnificent.line: From what I've seen, you're magnificent
stanza: From what I've seen, you're magnificent
You fight evil with all you do
It makes me lay here and love you

magnificent.line: La-la-la, la-la, la-la, la (I'm the Magnificent)
Of color and composition so magnificent
stanza: I have a friend, he's mostly made of pain
He wakes up, drives to work and straight back home again
He once cut one of my nightmares out of paper
I thought it was beautiful, I put it on a record cover
And I tried to tell him he had a sense
Of color and composition so magnificent
And he said, "Thank you, please, but your flattery
Your eyes are poor, you're blind, you see
No beauty could have come from me
Of breath, of space, of time"
